entries.speaker: Troubled Student
entries.en: There was another one of those strange[n]accidents...
entries.uk: Знову сталася одна з тих дивних[n]аварій...

entries.speaker: Troubled Student
entries.en: This time, it happened on a subway.[n]If it weren't a Sunday, I might have[n]been on it.
entries.uk: Цього разу в метро. Якби була[n]не неділя, я міг би там опинитися.

entries.speaker: Anxious Student
entries.en: That's really scary... How much longer do[n]you think this sort of thing will happen?
entries.uk: Як страшно... Як гадаєш, доки ще[n]таке триватиме?

entries.speaker: Anxious Student
entries.en: Come on, let's hurry. It's starting to rain.

entries.speaker: Troubled Student
entries.en: I don't have an umbrella. Today just isn't[n]my day.
entries.uk: А я без парасольки. Сьогодні явно[n]не мій день.
